Assistant (13.5s): Could you tell me the last four digits of the phone number on file?

User (15.5s): The last four digits are 4471.

Assistant (20.4s): I am calling from the collections team about a late payment. Your credit card ending 4821 has 420 past due and is 6 days late. Can you make this payment today?

User (21.4s): I can pay the full amount today.

Assistant (23.0s): To confirm, credit card ending 4821: 420 on Wednesday 14 October. Do you confirm?

User (24.2s): Yes, I confirm.

Assistant (27.2s): Your promise is recorded. You will receive a text message confirming this promise.

User (29.3s): Okay.

Assistant (31.1s): Thank you, goodbye.
